intro: This page lists down ore properties relevant to the game. These properties are properties that are crucial to gameplay or properties that some upgraders base their upgrades on.

There are a variety of status effects in the game, usually applied from a specific or group of upgrader/s. Most of these can be removed by Wild Spore, Deadly Spore, Azure Spore, The Death Cap and Resetting Devices.
Below is the most common status effect that you can apply to you ores.
Below is effect that grant immunity to certain status effects.
The table below illustrates specific cases regarding status effects. It will show an original status effect, then the result when passed through another.

Various ore materials are used in correspondence with status effects or as a way to signify change. An ore can only have one material at a time. Its material can be known by simply looking at its texture.
These properties do not retain to a specific category, but can still impact the way ores interact with items and effects.

effects.name: Fire
lines: Ignites ore for 4 seconds.
Can be extinguished with the use of items such as the Wild Spore or Freon Sprayer.

effects.name: Frostbite
lines: The polar opposite of fire. Ore inflicted with frostbite are set on a destruction timer unless the ore is set on fire, reverting the frostbite effect. The ore will still need to be extinguished.
Additionally, frostbite changes ore material to ice and paints ore blue.

effects.name: Radioactive
lines: Will explode ore after a period of time, destroying them.
Can be removed by Spore-related items.

effects.name: Sparkles
lines: Makes ores sparkle. Such ores may power the Northern Lights, but render the Azure Spore useless.
Can be removed by The Death Cap, Fractured Reality, Soul Blossom, or a Resetting Device.

effects.name: Poison
lines: Poisons the ore, gives green smoke particles, typically destroys it in 4 seconds if not removed.
Can be removed by Spore-related items.

effects.name: Smoking
lines: A variant of Poison given by the Robotic Enhancer, with grey smoke particles.
Shares almost the exact same attributes as Poison, but does not have a destruction timer.
Can be removed by Maintenance Supporter.

effects.name: Wet
lines: Extinguishes fire and gives ore a temporary fireproof effect.

effects.name: Anti-Gravity
lines: Applied by items such as Anti-Gravity Device.
Flips gravity of an ore, making it float upwards.
Can be removed by Gravity Normalizer.

effects.name: Fireproof
lines: Extinguishes fire and gives ore an immunity to "Fire".
Can be removed by Blazing Annihilator.
(Not to be confused with the Ice material.)

effects.name: Poison Immunity
lines: Grants immunity to the effect.
Can be removed by certain upgraders.

effects.name: Radioactive Immunity
lines: Grants immunity to the effect.
Can be removed by certain upgraders.

effects.name: Frostbite Immunity
lines: Grants immunity to the effect.
Can be removed by certain upgraders.

effects.name: Plague Immunity
lines: Grants a temporary immunity to "Plagued".

effects.name: Hydrophobic
lines: Given exclusively by the Honeycomb Cake and Famished Farm.
Prevents ores from being affected by wet effect.
Can be removed by Skydance Serenade.

effects.name: Education
lines: Has green illuminati-symbol particles.
Both effects have a period of waiting in which an ore cannot have its upgrade count changed, otherwise the ore is destroyed, and shields do not protect against it.
Both effects can be made instantaneous by using a Gargantium Core and their corresponding Pulsar.
Bypasses shields.

effects.name: Draedon
lines: Has blue polygonal particles.
Both effects have a period of waiting in which an ore cannot have its upgrade count changed, otherwise the ore is destroyed, and shields do not protect against it.
Both effects can be made instantaneous by using a Gargantium Core and their corresponding Pulsar.
Bypasses shields.

effects.name: Void
lines: Given exclusively by the Void Drive. Grants ore 3 seconds of complete immunity to destruction, it will be destroyed after the time is up.

effects.name: Shield
lines: Prevents ores from being destroyed.
Given exclusively by certain upgraders and dropped from certain mines(Not to be confused with the Forcefield material.)

effects.name: Gaia's Blessing
lines: Given exclusively by the Garden of Gaia.
Has the appearance of green particles. Adds a bonus x1.02 multiplier to all upgrades. Stacks with The Chaosrealm.

effects.name: Chaotic Fire
lines: Given exclusively by the The Chaosrealm.
Has the appearance of green fire particle. Adds a bonus x1.05 multiplier to all upgrades. Stacks with Garden of Gaia.

effects.name: Replicator Banned
lines: Given exclusively by the Methuselah's Mask, Leggendary Black Hole, and certain Quest-tier items.
Renders an ore incapable of being duplicated.
Cannot be removed by any means.

effects.name: Teleporter Banned
lines: Given exclusively by the Leggendary Black Hole while being upgraded.
Renders an ore incapable of being teleported by Teleporters. Despite this, you can still use Ore Nebula to teleport them.

effects.name: DON Banned
lines: Given exclusively by the Void Drive.
Renders the ore to be incapable to being "Pulse" by Devourer of Nightmares.

effects.name: Nova
lines: Grants a x4 boost to Star multipliers, or x25 boost to the Blue Supergiant.

effects.name: Nova-Schro
lines: Applies a 5-second x1.3 bonus to Schrodinger multipliers (not applied to Shop Schrodingers).

effects.name: Golden
lines: Given by various gold mines and certain upgraders.
Set ore material into foil and turn their color to yellow.

effects.name: Plague
lines: Ore gradually grow in size by 10% and destroys it once it reach 15 iteration.
Ores have a 5 seconds windows to remove the effect. After it is expired it cannot be removed.
Can be removed by Ghosdeeri's Antidote.

effects.name: Swag Factor
lines: Given exclusively by the Lucky Hat.
Swag.

effects.name: Stasis
lines: Ore becomes stationary for a specified amount of time.
The Eggscream Refiner can stasis ores for 7 seconds.

effects.name: Eternal Flame
lines: Given exclusively by the Solar Apocalypse.
It has the same appearance as "Fire" but does not destroy ores.
Ores with Eternal Flames are processed at a higher rate by the Awakened Jack O Lantern.
Ores with "Fireproof" will not be set on fire.

reactions: Ore proceeds normally and will not get the effect.
Ore proceeds with its original effect and can be killed if original effect is not removed, but can no longer be inflicted with said effect, if removed.
Effects will not stack. Given wet effect, fireproof will not be applied, and given fireproof effect, wet will not be applied.
Frostbite is removed and replaced with fire.
EXCEPTION: If ore is fireproof/wet before being given the fire, frostbite will not be removed.
And vice versa: smoking and poison can coexist in one ore.
Ore will not be held frozen in place; instead it will proceed normally. Fire will not be extinguished.
Ore will be destroyed, unless timer is finished.
EXCEPTION: If succeeding upgraders all have exactly 0 upgrade counter, ore will not be destroyed while the timer goes on. Negative counter will still destroy ore.
EXCEPTION 2: Instant Draedon/Instant Education effects will reduce the timer to 0; however, ore needs to get its upgrade counter changed after, for it to be upgraded.
100% guarantee that first blaster after gaining a shield will always upgrade and never destroy ore. Void Drive gives 15 shields and the voided effect.

materials.name: Ice
lines: Corresponding material for frozen status effect. Ores have less friction and can slide off of conveyor turns.
By changing the ore's material, the frozen status effect can be reverted.
(Note: The ice material does not correspond to the fireproof effect.)

materials.name: Neon
lines: Makes ore glow.
Requirement for using The Cosmic Tower, or a larger multiplier from the Optic Origin.

materials.name: Diamond Plate
lines: Used to show an ore has been forged; increased density.
Required to power the Radio Tower.

materials.name: Pebble
lines: Corresponding to The Death Cap's ability to clear (almost) all status effects.
Has no in-game purpose.

materials.name: Forcefield
lines: Material that allows the Optic Origin to give its highest multiplier. Exclusively given by the Helium Blaster, Soaring Chopper and Forsaken Battleground. Despite the name, this type of material won't give your ores any resistance.
(Not to be confused with the Shield effect.)

materials.name: Glass
lines: Material usually used corresponding to the "Wet" status effect. Also given by the Shiny Red Upgrader.
This material has no gameplay significance as no upgraders have effects to this material.

materials.name: Granite
lines: A material that is given to ore dropped by the Witch's Cauldron and a few selected droppers.
Required to power The Eternal Overseer.

materials.name: CrackedLava
lines: Material given exclusively by Doom Incarnate's Flamethrower upgrade.
Has no in-game purpose.

materials.name: Sand
lines: Material given by the Chocolate Cupcake, and Aromatic Holidays.
Has no in-game purpose.

properties.name: Ore Value
lines: The value of an ore.
The Tyrant's Throne and Ooftopian Refiner both have stats that are dependent on the ores value.

properties.name: Volume
lines: The size of an ore in terms of length, width, and height. Different dropper types produce different size ore.
In the unique case of The Dust Devil, its multiplier is based on the ores size.

properties.name: Density
lines: The measurement of an ore's mass per unit of volume. A small ore may be heavy and a large ore may be light depending on their densities.
Not to be confused with the ore's mass, directly proportional to its volume and density, which is what should be taken into account when using an Ore Cannon or similar items.

properties.name: Transparency
lines: Defines the transparency of an ore.
The only item in the game that processes an ore based on its transparency is the Hungry Spirit.
The only item in the game that can set an ore's transparency to 1 (i.e., invisible) is the Hopeless Bog.

properties.name: Elasticity
lines: Bounciness of an ore.
This property determines how much does ore bounce against the collision surface. Only item that currently modifies the property is Jelly Cake.

properties.name: Color
lines: The color of an ore.
Some items such as the Santa's Castle have additional effects if the ore is a certain color. In this case, a +3 to the multiplier if the ores color is red or green.

properties.name: Upgrade Count
lines: The upgrade count of an ore is measured by its reflectance multiplied by 20.
Some upgraders base their upgrades on the ore's upgrade count, such as the Hades' Palace.

properties.name: Machine Tag
lines: A tag that prevents ore from being used passed a certain number of times for certain upgraders. When an ore passes through a Resetting Device, all of the ore's machine tags are removed (except for tags from upgraders that are not resettable).
